members.title: Members
members.name: Name
members.empty: No members yet — try the Import page.

atRisk.title: At risk
atRisk.hint: Members with an open critical (red) alert.

earlyWarning.title: Early warning
earlyWarning.hint: Members with an open high-priority (amber) alert.

coaches.title: Coaches
coaches.hint: Coaches promoted from class-session data, plus any added here. Linking a session's coach to one of these enables per-coach retention drill-down on the Dashboards page.
coaches.name: Name

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Applies to the app's own interface — not the language messages are sent to members in.
settings.rulesHint: The alert rules running for your box: what they check, and whether they're on.
settings.enabledHint: Turns this rule off for your box — it stops creating new alerts, existing ones are unaffected.

healthScore.title: Health score weights
healthScore.hint: How much each factor counts toward the composite Health Score. Must sum to 100% before saving.
healthScore.coldStartHint: Members below both minimums get "not enough history" instead of a score.

alerts.title: Alert inbox
alerts.runEscalationHint: Runs the SLA escalation sweep now (also runs every 15 min automatically).
alerts.claimHint: Assigns this alert to you so it drops off other coaches' queue. Anyone can claim any alert.
alerts.sendMessageHint: Send a template or custom message to this member right now, outside the automated rules.
alerts.resolveHint: Closes the alert with an outcome. Just a record — it doesn't message the member or change anything else.
alerts.empty: Nothing here — the daily rule run (or "Run escalation sweep") creates/updates alerts.

retention.pageHint: How many members you have, and how well you're keeping them — active counts, join-month cohort curves, and how long members typically stick around before cancelling.
retention.cohortHint: % of each join-month cohort still active, by months since joining.
retention.rangeEmpty: No cohorts joined in this range.
retention.tenureHint: How long members stuck around before cancelling.

aiSummary.title: AI summary
aiSummary.hint: An AI-generated explanation of the retention numbers above — it only ever describes the data shown here, never new numbers.
aiSummary.notConfiguredTooltip: AI summaries aren't configured for this environment.
aiSummary.evidenceToggle: Show the data this summary is based on
aiSummary.error: Couldn't generate an AI summary right now — please try again later.

alertOps.pageHint: How well the team is catching and responding to at-risk members: how fast alerts get claimed, whether outreach actually brings people back, and what kind of alerts you're getting.
alertOps.volumeHint: How many alerts were raised, by how urgent they are (severity) and what triggered them (family).
alertOps.outcomesHint: What happened to alerts once they were resolved.

workouts.pageHint: When members train, what they train, and how full classes are — use it to spot underused slots or shifting workout-type popularity.
workouts.windowsHint: Windows: Early before 08:00 · Morning 08:00–11:00 · Lunch 11:00–14:00 · Afternoon 14:00–17:00 · Evening after 17:00
workouts.empty: No attended visits in the last 12 weeks.
workouts.fillHint: Average % of capacity booked, by class type and time window, last 12 weeks.
workouts.fillEmpty: No capacity data in the last 12 weeks.
workouts.recentHint: Last 20 sessions with a logged workout, last 12 weeks — hover a workout for its description.
workouts.recentEmpty: No recent sessions with a logged workout.

myWeek.pageHint: Your open coaching queue — alerts assigned to your role or claimed by you, due this week.
myWeek.openCoachHint: Alerts currently assigned to the Coach role or claimed by you, not yet resolved.
myWeek.dueThisWeekHint: Of the open alerts above, how many are due before this week ends.

openAlerts.title: Open alerts
openAlerts.empty: No open alerts for this member.

manualTriggers.recomputeHealthScoreHint: Runs the health score calculation for this member only, right now.
manualTriggers.rerunRulesHint: Runs the daily alert rule check for this member only, right now.

risk.title: Churn risk
risk.hint: ML prediction (plan §8) — not used to drive alerts yet; visible to Manager/Owner only.
risk.reasonsHint: These compare the member's own recent visits to their own past pattern (e.g. "pace" = visits per week) — not to other members.
risk.empty: No score yet — runs weekly (Sunday), or trigger it from the alert inbox.

healthScore.title: Health score
healthScore.hint: A composite 0-100 score from attendance, consistency, booking behaviour, goal progress and engagement — deterministic and configurable, not a prediction.
healthScore.insufficientHint: This member hasn't been around long enough (or hasn't trained enough sessions) for a reliable score.
healthScore.empty: No score yet — runs daily, or trigger it from Settings.

notes.title: Notes
notes.hint: Context for coaches — e.g. "recovering from a knee injury". Notes can be added here or arrive from an import.

forms.title: Evaluation forms
forms.hint: Send a form link — the member answers without logging in; negative or health flags create an alert automatically.

consent.title: Consent
consent.hint: Which channels this member can be messaged on. Defaults to granted until revoked.

workoutMix.title: Workout mix
workoutMix.hint: Attended workout types over the last 4 months, by tag.
workoutMix.empty: No tagged attended workouts in the last 4 months.

payments.title: Payments
payments.hint: Payments recorded for this member — collected elsewhere (cash, card terminal, bank transfer); not a payment processor.

import.title: Import
import.hint: Excel workbook with sheets {members}, {classes}, {attendance}, and optionally {notes} (member_id, note). Re-uploading the same file is safe — it updates existing rows instead of duplicating them.

login.bootstrapLink: First time? Set up your box

bootstrap.title: Set up your box
bootstrap.subtitle: This only works once — the first Owner account.
